mapper.select: select L.ID, L.RECORD_ID, L.FROM_STATUS, L.TO_STATUS, L.ACTION, L.OPERATOR_ID, NVL(U.FULLNAME, L.OPERATOR_NAME) as OPERATOR_NAME, L.COMMENT_TEXT, L.OP_TIME from QA_FA_AUDIT_LOG L left join USERPROFILE U on U.USERNAME = L.OPERATOR_ID where L.RECORD_ID = #{recordId} order by L.OP_TIME asc
